ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-pixel mass across both lobes, interspersed with high-contrast linear white filaments primarily concentrated in the lower-left quadrant and central-right regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 45 degrees, centered between symmetrical lobe curvatures.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude oscillations at the distal tips; transitioning to moderate-frequency serrations along the trailing edge toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast tan/white pixel groupings at both the extreme left and right distal tips, indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant density of multi-directional, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the mid-to-lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the central ventral area and significant bio-fouling/barnacle clusters localized at the fluke tips.
